items.title: Jensen Huang isn’t out of the woods yet
items.summary: It’s safe to say no one expected this. Monday morning, Jensen Huang returned as CEO of Nvidia, after resigning the position following news of multiple affairs, including one with a subordinate and one with a woman tied to Chinese intelligence services. With so much of the AI industry built on top of Nvidia’s AI infrastructure, […]
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: Trump reportedly called into Nvidia board meeting to advocate for Huang’s return
items.summary: "I spoke to them, let me put it that way... And I convinced them," the president told CNBC.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling

items.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion
items.summary: The cybersecurity giant said that the deal to buy Zscaler, which provides zero-trust products to large enterprises, will better equip their customers to use AI agents.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker
